description: Search YouTube videos, shorts and streams by keyword with YouTube's filters (upload date, type, length, features): title, description, views, likes, comments, duration, hashtags, subtitles and the channel's subscribers. 5 points per returned record.

date_filter.description: Upload date. Options: hour = Last hour, today = Today, week = This week, month = This month, year = This year

download_subtitles.description: Download subtitles (when present on the video)

length_filter.description: Length. Options: under4 = Under 4 minutes, between420 = 4-20 minutes, plus20 = Over 20 minutes

query.description: Search term. e.g. web scraping tutorial

sorting_order.description: Sorting order. Options: rating = Rating, date = Upload date, views = View count

subtitles_format.description: Subtitle format. Options: vtt = WEBVTT, xml = XML, plaintext = Plain text

subtitles_language.description: Subtitle language. Options: any = Any, de = German, es = Spanish, fr = French, it = Italian, ja = Japanese, ko = Korean, nl = Dutch, pt = Portuguese, ru = Russian

video_type.description: Type. Options: video = Video, movie = Film

name: run_youtube_search
title: YouTube search
